title: tanacetum sevanense
intro: Tanacetum sevanense, commonly known as Caucasian tansy, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum sevanense are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
